Needs changes before merge.

The parameter edits support undo, project files, and MCP. The motion layer checks the engagement limit and return clearance. The default path still matches its existing golden file.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:616`: The trial merge with `upstream/main` at `25121045bc712aa46c4cdbea091c331d51af0611` failed. Code conflicts also occur in `crates/app/src/operation/types/params.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/params.rs`, `crates/app/src/project/params_impl.rs`, `crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs`, and `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs`. At merge time, merge main into this branch, resolve these conflicts, and run the tests again. Keep both parameter sets and their checks.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/kind_editors.rs:94`: Add before and after screenshots to the PR body. Show the Passes and Feeds tabs with Method set to Trochoidal. Include the Microlift height control. The body has no screenshots for these UI changes.

Local build and test results:

The trial merge failed, so all builds and tests used the unchanged PR head. These results do not verify the combined code from this PR and main. No GitHub runner was used. The quick gate command used `--dry-run` to show the test plan only; the full quick gate was not run.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Motion test build: library, optimal_load, trochoid_slot | Passed |
| App test build: library, adaptive_trochoid, pick_agnostic, roughing2d, project_roundtrip | Passed |
| Motion Adaptive Trochoidal unit tests | 14 passed |
| Motion optimal_load | 4 passed |
| Motion trochoid_slot | 11 passed |
| App adaptive_trochoid | 8 passed |
| App pick_agnostic | 5 passed, 2 ignored |
| App roughing2d | 7 passed |
| App project_roundtrip | 73 passed |
| UI library, from crates/ui | 777 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| UI adaptive_method tests, separate run | 3 passed |
| Clippy: motion, app, UI; all targets; warnings denied | Passed |

The UI library failure is an environment limit. `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` failed at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests.rs:1897`:

```text
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in; hardware adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in
```

Safety checks:

This is a safety-tier change because it changes toolpath generation and thus posted G-code. I ran two of the stated mutations in the local review worktree:

- Restore the previous validation code in `operation/types/sane.rs`: `trochoidal_doors_refuse_out_of_range_and_over_clearance_values_by_name` failed because it accepted 181 degrees. Restore the PR file: the test passed.
- Restore the fixed engagement, return mode, return feed, and loop width in `adaptive_troch::cut_lane`: `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width` failed because it accepted the 10-degree limit. Restore the PR file: the test passed.

Both mutations failed with test exit code 101 and passed with exit code 0 after restoration. All temporary changes were removed. No golden files changed in this PR. The existing default-path golden check passed. The full UI could not be checked without a graphics adapter.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merged upstream/main at 085a4717. Kept both parameter sets and the Trochoidal arc-turn refusal. The new test `merged_arc_and_trochoidal_parameters_round_trip_and_keep_the_arc_refusal` pins project round trips and both edit and generation refusals. Removing the generation guard failed RED. Restoring it passed GREEN.

Added before and after Passes and Feeds screenshots to the PR body. The after Passes image shows Trochoidal and Microlift height. The extended test `trochoidal_method_shows_its_passes_and_feeds_fields_and_spiral_and_offset_hide_them` pins height visibility. Removing the height row failed RED. Restoring it passed GREEN. The screenshot README explains the CPU rendering fallback.

Quick gate: motion and app passed. UI had 802 passes, one failure and five ignored tests. The only failure was `headless_run_succeeds`, because this environment has no graphics adapter. Strict clippy passed for app and motion. UI strict clippy failed only on existing macOS dead-code warnings for `PNG_256` and `taskbar_icon`. No unrelated code was changed.

Merge-time refresh: not done. The PR stays at head 77b47aa96 with the label `conflicts`. Nothing was pushed.

The conflict is not mechanical. Main changed the generator after this PR was written (`cf06258f1`, issue 1587, and `104dbc238`).

- On main, `adaptive_trochoidal` uses the multi-lane planner (`plan_all_lanes`, `plan_cleanup`). The production path does not call `cut_lane`.
- On main, `adaptive_troch_lanes.rs` sets the values that this PR makes parameters: `plan_lane_safe` sets the engagement limit, and `trochoid_params` sets `return_feed: p.feed` and `loop_width: None`.
- If a merge keeps the two sides, the code compiles, but `AdaptiveTrochParams` has no effect on the toolpath. The test `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width` then fails.

Necessary work, by the author:

1. Merge `origin/main` into the branch.
2. Pass the parameters through `plan_all_lanes`, `plan_lane_safe`, `trochoid_params` and the cleanup.
3. Keep the refusals of main: the optimal load below 4 %, the confinement refusal and the self-crossing refusal.
4. Keep the two test blocks.

This is new code in toolpath generation. The PR then gets a full review of the new head.

Merged upstream/main at 7c514c87. The production multi-lane planner now receives the Trochoidal controls. Cleanup uses the actual loop band and bounds its step by the requested engagement limit. The final path retains main's confinement and self-crossing checks and the below-4% optimal-load refusal. Both original test blocks remain.

Pins:
- Parameter forwarding: `explicit_trochoidal_parameters_control_engagement_return_feed_and_loop_width`, `custom_parameters_reach_parallel_and_closed_lane_layouts`, and `custom_return_feed_is_emitted_by_production_parallel_lanes_and_cleanup`.
- Cleanup engagement: `cleanup_front_respects_custom_engagement_limit` and the existing MCP test `mcp_edits_trochoidal_parameters_generates_refuses_limits_and_round_trips`. The 60-degree MCP case exposed excessive cleanup engagement; tighter corner spacing now passes it without weakening the final check.
- Main's refusals: `low_load_bounds_cleanup_spacing_and_complete_path` and `merged_production_checks_refuse_outside_and_self_crossing_paths`.

Removing production parameter forwarding, the cleanup angle bound, the load floor, confinement, and self-crossing checks each failed RED. Restoring each passed GREEN.

Full quick gate: GREEN (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`, three steps, zero failures). Strict clippy for app, motion, and UI, all targets: GREEN. App Trochoidal tests: 12 passed. UI library: 815 passed, 6 ignored; headless passed.
